## Summary

A short, clear description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behaviour or interface you'd like. Code examples are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you thought of, and why you prefer the proposed one.

## Additional context

Any other context, links to related issues, or prior art.
